rung: canonical two-seed outcome-trained stable-no-op and shifted-replacement trigger
claim_boundary: Outcome-trained raw-value regime detector keeps stable incoming evidence as an exact no-op and triggers a verifier-gated external scope replacement after a structural shift; not autonomous semantic change-point discovery, arbitrary new computation, unrestricted memory growth, or general continual learning.

accounting.stable_bits_to_threshold: 1000 detector and 1000 structure-policy scalar updates; both stable/no-op and shifted/replacement gates passed on both seeds
accounting.retention_on_mastered_primitives: 6 protected routes retained; 12 old working routes removed; 12 new working routes admitted
accounting.transfer_ratio_against_fresh_detector: trained mean stable/shift accuracy was 1.0 on both seeds; fresh means were 0.5, with each fresh seed missing a different class

controls: held-out stable keep and shifted replace detector transfer
next_bottleneck: Repeat alternating unknown-boundary regimes with multiple protected scopes and explicit capacity pressure without replay.
